units.title: Applications of Integration
units.blurb: Find areas, volumes, arc lengths, work, fluid force and centers of mass.

units.title: Techniques of Integration
units.blurb: Integrate by parts, with trig identities and substitutions, with partial fractions, and numerically.

units.title: First Differential Equations
units.blurb: Meet differential equations, slope fields, Euler's method, separable equations and logistic growth.

units.title: Parametric and Polar Calculus
units.blurb: Find slopes, areas and lengths for parametric and polar curves.

units.title: Sequences and Series
units.blurb: Decide whether sequences and series converge, and estimate sums.

units.title: Power Series
units.blurb: Represent functions as power series and Taylor series, and use them.

topics.title: Area Between Curves
topics.short: Integrate top minus bottom, or right minus left.
topics.trouble: Students subtract in the wrong order where the curves cross, so pieces cancel.

topics.title: Volume by Slicing
topics.short: Add up the areas of thin cross-sections.

topics.title: Disks and Washers
topics.short: Revolve a region: V = π∫(R² − r²) dx.
topics.trouble: Students square the difference, using (R − r)² instead of R² − r².

topics.title: Cylindrical Shells
topics.short: V = 2π∫(radius)(height) dx.
topics.trouble: Students use the wrong radius when the axis of rotation is not an axis of coordinates.

topics.title: Arc Length
topics.trouble: Students forget to square the derivative inside the root.

topics.title: Work
topics.short: Work is force times distance, added up over thin pieces.
topics.trouble: Students use one distance for the whole tank when each layer of liquid travels a different distance.

topics.title: Hydrostatic Force
topics.short: Pressure grows with depth, so integrate strips across the surface.

topics.title: Moments and Centers of Mass
topics.short: Balance points of thin plates.

topics.title: Hyperbolic Functions
topics.short: cosh and sinh, their identities and derivatives.
topics.trouble: Students borrow trig identities without changing the signs, writing cosh²x + sinh²x = 1.

topics.title: Integration by Parts
topics.short: ∫u dv = uv − ∫v du reverses the product rule.
topics.trouble: Students choose u so that the new integral is harder than the original.

topics.title: Trigonometric Integrals
topics.short: Use identities for powers of sine, cosine, tangent and secant.

topics.title: Trigonometric Substitution
topics.short: Replace √(a² − x²) and similar roots with trig functions.
topics.trouble: Students forget to change back to x with a reference triangle.

topics.title: Integration by Partial Fractions
topics.short: Split a rational function into pieces you can integrate.
topics.trouble: Students try partial fractions before dividing when the numerator's degree is too high.

topics.title: Choosing a Technique
topics.short: Recognize which method fits an integral.

topics.title: Trapezoid and Simpson's Rules
topics.short: Approximate integrals with trapezoids and parabolas.
topics.trouble: Students use an odd number of subintervals for Simpson's rule.

topics.title: Improper Integrals
topics.short: Integrals over infinite intervals or across infinite values are limits.
topics.trouble: Students integrate straight across a vertical asymptote, so ∫ from −1 to 1 of 1/x² looks like −2.

topics.title: Comparison Test for Improper Integrals
topics.short: Compare with a simpler integral to decide convergence.

topics.title: What a Differential Equation Is
topics.short: An equation with a derivative; a solution is a function that satisfies it.
topics.trouble: Students check a solution by plugging in a number instead of the whole function.

topics.title: Direction Fields and Euler's Method
topics.short: Sketch solutions from slopes, and step along them numerically.
topics.trouble: Students use the slope at the new point instead of the current point in Euler's method.

topics.title: Separable Equations
topics.short: Move each variable to its own side and integrate.
topics.trouble: Students add the constant after exponentiating, or lose solutions such as y = 0 when dividing.

topics.title: The Logistic Equation
topics.short: dP/dt = rP(1 − P/K) models growth with a limit.

topics.title: Tangents and Arc Length for Parametric Curves
topics.short: dy/dx = (dy/dt)/(dx/dt).
topics.trouble: Students divide dx/dt by dy/dt.

topics.title: Area in Polar Coordinates
topics.short: A = ½∫r² dθ.
topics.trouble: Students use the wrong θ limits and count a loop twice.

topics.title: Polar Tangents and Arc Length
topics.short: Treat a polar curve as parametric in θ.

topics.title: Sequences and Their Limits
topics.short: A sequence converges when its terms approach one number.
topics.trouble: Students confuse the limit of the terms with the sum of the terms.

topics.title: Monotone and Bounded Sequences
topics.short: An increasing sequence with an upper bound converges.

topics.title: Series and Partial Sums
topics.short: A series converges when its partial sums approach a number.
topics.trouble: Students think a series converges because its terms go to 0.

topics.title: Geometric and Telescoping Series
topics.short: Sum geometric series and series whose terms cancel.

topics.title: The Divergence Test
topics.short: If the terms do not go to 0, the series diverges.
topics.trouble: Students use the test to claim a series converges when its terms do go to 0.

topics.title: The Integral Test and p-Series
topics.short: Compare a series with an improper integral; Σ1/nᵖ converges when p > 1.
topics.trouble: Students think the series and the integral have the same value.

topics.title: Comparison and Limit Comparison Tests
topics.short: Compare with a known series.
topics.trouble: Students compare in the wrong direction, showing a series is smaller than a divergent one.

topics.title: Alternating Series
topics.short: Terms that shrink to 0 and alternate in sign give a convergent series.
topics.trouble: Students skip checking that the terms decrease.

topics.title: Absolute and Conditional Convergence
topics.short: Test Σ|aₙ| to learn how a series converges.

topics.title: Ratio and Root Tests
topics.short: Look at the limit of |aₙ₊₁/aₙ| or |aₙ|^(1/n).
topics.trouble: Students conclude convergence or divergence when the limit equals 1, where the test says nothing.

topics.title: Choosing a Convergence Test
topics.short: Match the series to the test that fits.

topics.title: Estimating the Sum of a Series
topics.short: Bound the error of a partial sum.

topics.title: Power Series and Intervals of Convergence
topics.short: Find where Σcₙ(x − a)ⁿ converges.
topics.trouble: Students forget to test the endpoints of the interval separately.

topics.title: Representing Functions as Power Series
topics.short: Build series from 1/(1 − x).

topics.title: Differentiating and Integrating Power Series
topics.short: Work term by term inside the interval of convergence.

topics.title: Taylor and Maclaurin Series
topics.short: cₙ = f⁽ⁿ⁾(a)/n!.
topics.trouble: Students forget the n! in the denominator.

topics.title: Taylor's Inequality
topics.short: Bound the error of a Taylor polynomial.

topics.title: Working with Known Series
topics.short: Build new series from those for eˣ, sin x, cos x and ln(1 + x).

topics.title: The Binomial Series
topics.short: (1 + x)ᵏ as a series for any k.

topics.title: Applications of Series
topics.short: Use series for limits, integrals and approximations.
